paragraphs: Sirna and Sons Produce, Inc is recalling Sirna & Sons Produce PEPPER JALAPENO BREAK 1LB because of a salmonella risk, according to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. The recall was initiated on August 5, 2026.

body.heading: Where it was sold or distributed
paragraphs: OH, PA (for food service use only)

body.heading: What consumers should do
paragraphs: Consumers can review the FDA recall record for product and distribution details.
